image.description: WordPress container image, e.g. wordpress:php8.4. Raising the tag upgrades PHP/WordPress on the next rollout

nginx.description: nginx Ingress for the site. Created only when host is set

host.description: Hostname the site is served on, e.g. blog.example.com. Leave empty and no Ingress is created (reach it by port-forwarding the Service on port 80 instead)

tlsHost.description: Hostname to put in the TLS certificate. Defaults to the host above; set it only when the certificate is issued for a different name

tlsSecretName.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes TLS secret holding the certificate for that host

env.description: Environment the WordPress container runs with

WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX.description: Prefix for WordPress table names, e.g. wp_. Two sites can share one database if they use different prefixes. Changing it on a live site hides all existing content

WORDPRESS_DEBUG.description: Set to the string '1' to turn on WordPress debug mode (WP_DEBUG); the value is a string, not the number 1. Leave empty for production - it prints PHP warnings to visitors

WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA.description: Extra PHP appended to wp-config.php. This is where you pin the public site URL, e.g. define('WP_HOME','https://blog.example.com'); define('WP_SITEURL','https://blog.example.com');

minCPU.description: CPU reserved for each WordPress pod, e.g. 250m

minMemory.description: Memory reserved for each WordPress pod, e.g. 1000Mi

maxCPU.description: CPU ceiling for each WordPress pod, e.g. 500m

maxMemory.description: Memory ceiling for each WordPress pod, e.g. 1500Mi

minReplicas.description: Number of WordPress pods. Keep at 1 unless the storage below is switched to a ReadWriteMany volume - several pods cannot share a ReadWriteOnce disk

volumeMounts.description: Storage attached to the WordPress container

pvc.description: Disks mounted into WordPress. The default entry gives /var/www/html a 10Gi volume so uploads, themes and plugins survive a restart. Set "storage" to change the size, at install time only - a live volume cannot be resized

diskSize.description: Disk for the bundled MySQL, e.g. 10Gi. Fixed at install time - a live volume cannot be resized afterwards
